description: This script manages the preparation and validation of pull requests, including branch management, syncing with main, and verifying commit subjects for a version control workflow.

methods.name: checkout_prep_branch
methods.description: Checks out the preparation branch based on PR number.

methods.name: resolve_prep_branch_name
methods.description: Resolves and verifies the name of the preparation branch for a given PR.

methods.name: verify_prep_branch_matches_prepared_head
methods.description: Verifies that the local prep branch matches the expected commit SHA.

methods.name: prepare_init
methods.description: Initializes the preparation environment for a PR, fetching and checking out the PR branch.

methods.name: prepare_validate_commit
methods.description: Validates the latest commit message in the PR to ensure it doesn't contain forbidden info.

methods.name: prepare_push
methods.description: Pushes the prepared branch to the PR branch after passing gates and checks.

methods.name: prepare_sync_head
methods.description: Synchronizes the prep branch with main, rebasing if necessary, and updates related metadata.

methods.name: prepare_run
methods.description: Runs the full preparation process sequence: init, gates, push.
